title: COMP Other Common Page
summary: Official Derivative common page for miscellaneous COMPs, covering shortcuts, internal OPs, operator viewer, clone, load-on-demand, external .tox, reload, backup, sub-component load, and relative path behavior.
guidance: Use this article for miscellaneous COMPs with shared shortcut, clone, external .tox, and relative path behavior.
Enable External .tox controls whether startup loads from the referenced .tox or from contents saved in the .toe.
Reload Custom Parameters and Reload Built-In Parameters affect only top-level parameters; internal nodes still reload from the .tox.
Sub-Component to Load can pull a named COMP from inside a .tox and make it the top-level loaded COMP.
Relative path behavior can inherit, resolve relative to the .toe, or resolve relative to the external .tox.
